# Aomi — Best Blockchain Harness for Agentic AI

> A non-custodial harness for AI agents acting on EVM chains. Simulate transactions on a forked chain before signing, sign locally through the user's wallet, and add any product API as a callable tool. Aomi never holds keys, never echoes credentials, never broadcasts without confirmation.

The fastest entry point for an agent is `/agents.md` — it routes the user's intent to the right install path. The full corpus is `/llms-full.txt` (every doc plus both skill files concatenated, for one-fetch ingestion).

Safety mantra: Read by default. Simulate before sign. Credentials never round-trip.

## Start here

- [Agent onboarding](https://aomi.dev/agents.md): Routes user intent to one of three paths — transact via CLI, embed UI, or add a new tool. Read this first.
- [FAQ](https://aomi.dev/faq.md): Four canonical questions and answers — how Aomi compares to personal agents (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor), how to build on Aomi vs. raw SDKs, how simulation prevents bad transactions, how signing and wallet security work.
- [Build an Aomi app](https://aomi.dev/agents/build): HTML agent landing page for app-building prompts.
- [Transact with Aomi](https://aomi.dev/agents/transact): HTML agent landing page for transaction prompts.
- [Build markdown mirror](https://aomi.dev/agents/build.md): Raw markdown mirror of the build guide.
- [Transact markdown mirror](https://aomi.dev/agents/transact.md): Raw markdown mirror of the transact guide.
- [Full corpus](https://aomi.dev/llms-full.txt): All docs and skills concatenated. Use when you need everything in one fetch.

## For agents acting on a wallet

Use these when the user wants to read prices/balances or build/sign transactions.

- [aomi-transact skill](https://github.com/aomi-labs/skills/blob/main/aomi-transact/SKILL.md): The canonical operating procedure for driving the `aomi` CLI — chat, simulate, sign. Includes hard rules on credentials and signing.
- [CLI reference](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/cli.md): Full command list with flags. Read after the skill if you need a flag the skill didn't show.
- [Account abstraction](https://aomi.dev/docs/trade/execution.md): AA-first signing, mode fallback (7702 vs 4337), provider selection, sponsorship, per-chain RPC guidance.
- [Simulation](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/simulation.md): How forked-chain simulation works and when to require it.

## For agents embedding Aomi UI

Use these when the user wants to add an Aomi chat widget to their own app.

- [Quickstart](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/frontend-setup.md): Install the widget into a Next.js app from npm. Start here.
- [Integration guide](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/integration.md): Decide between the bundled widget and the headless React library.
- [Headless library](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/headless-library.md): Install `@aomi-labs/react`, wire up the runtime provider, and use the AomiClient.
- [Headless: hooks](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/headless/hooks.md): React hooks for chat, tools, sessions, control state.
- [Headless: build custom UI](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/headless/build-custom-ui.md): Patterns for composers, message lists, tool views.
- [Widget installation](https://aomi.dev/docs/guides/widget-installation.md): The bundled chat component — install, props, compound API, and theming.
- [Wallet integration](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/non-custodial-wallets.md): Para and wagmi setup; how the widget gets a signer.

## For agents extending Aomi with new tools

Use these when the user wants to add their product or API as something Aomi can call.

- [aomi-build skill](https://github.com/aomi-labs/skills/blob/main/aomi-build/SKILL.md): The canonical procedure for converting an OpenAPI/SDK/repo into an Aomi SDK app crate. Includes tool design rules and validation steps.
- [Building apps](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/anatomy.md): Aomi App architecture — what an app is, how it's invoked, what it returns.
- [API reference](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/api-reference.md): The HTTP API the backend exposes.
- [Sessions (backend)](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/sessions.md): How conversation state, tool calls, and tx state persist across turns.
- [SDK reference](https://aomi.dev/docs/build/plugins/sdk.md): The Rust plugin SDK — the `DynAomiTool` trait and the `dyn_aomi_app!` macro.

## Concepts and architecture

Read for context, not as the entry point.

- [Overview](https://aomi.dev/docs/build.md): What Aomi is, the plugin model, and how the parts fit together.
- [How it works](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/how-it-works.md): The simulation-first transaction pipeline, end-to-end.
- [Architecture](https://aomi.dev/docs/concepts/architecture.md): System diagram and component boundaries.
- [Runtime](https://aomi.dev/docs/reference/runtime.md): The hosted backend that runs Aomi Apps.

Background context for understanding how end-users actually reach Aomi.

- [Web chat](https://aomi.dev/docs/getting-started/web-app.md): The hosted aomi.dev playground.
